theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 6 群

items.colloc: use a watering can 使用澆水壺 | fill a watering can 裝滿澆水壺
items.distinct: sprinkler 自動灑水系統 | hose 水管
ex: Please fill the watering can at the sink.
請在洗手台把澆水壺裝滿。
She grabbed the watering can to tend the flowers.
她拿起澆水壺去照料花卉。
The gardener left his watering can by the gate.
園丁把他的澆水壺留在門邊。

items.colloc: eye-catching window display 吸睛的櫥窗展示 | design a window display 設計櫥窗
items.distinct: storefront 店面 | showcase 陳列櫃
ex: The new window display attracts many passing customers.
新的櫥窗展示吸引了許多過路顧客。
Our team is working on the holiday window display.
我們的團隊正在製作節日的櫥窗展示。
Take a look at the window display before entering.
進去前先看一下櫥窗展示。

items.colloc: a couple of days 幾天 | a couple of minutes 幾分鐘
items.distinct: a few 幾個（數量稍多）| a pair of 一雙
ex: I will be back in a couple of minutes.
我幾分鐘後就回來。
There are a couple of errors in the report.
報告中有幾個錯誤。
They have worked together for a couple of years.
他們已經共事幾年了。

items.colloc: a sheet of paper 一張紙 | a sheet of glass 一片玻璃
items.distinct: a piece of 一塊；一片 | a stack of 一疊
ex: Please sign on a sheet of blank paper.
請在一張白紙上簽名。
He handed me a sheet of instructions.
他遞給我一張說明書。
Each applicant needs a sheet of registration form.
每位申請者需要一張登記表。

items.colloc: accept an award onstage 在台上領獎 | graciously accept an award 優雅地領獎
items.distinct: receive an award 收到獎項 | win an award 得獎
ex: The CEO will accept an award at the ceremony.
執行長將在典禮上接受獎項。
He was invited to accept an award for innovation.
他受邀領取一項創新獎。
She is preparing her speech to accept an award.
她正在準備領獎致詞。

items.zh: 公開出席儀式；亮相儀式
items.colloc: attend an appearance ceremony 出席儀式 | host an appearance ceremony 主持儀式
items.distinct: opening ceremony 開幕典禮 | award ceremony 頒獎典禮
ex: The guests gathered for the appearance ceremony.
貴賓們聚集參加出席儀式。
Attendance at the appearance ceremony is mandatory.
出席這場亮相儀式是強制的。
We scheduled the appearance ceremony for tomorrow morning.
我們把出席儀式安排在明天早上。

items.colloc: fill out an application form 填寫申請表 | submit an application form 繳交申請表
items.distinct: registration form 報名表 | questionnaire 問卷
ex: Please complete the application form in black ink.
請用黑筆填寫申請表。
You can download the application form online.
你可以在線上下載申請表。
The application form must be signed by the manager.
申請表必須由經理簽名。

items.colloc: be based on facts 根據事實 | be based on experience 基於經驗
items.distinct: depend on 取決於 | rely on 依賴
ex: The decision will be based on the latest data.
這項決定將根據最新數據。
Our marketing strategy is based on customer feedback.
我們的行銷策略基於顧客回饋。
The movie is based on a true corporate story.
這部電影根據真實企業故事改編。

items.colloc: be familiar with the procedure 熟悉流程 | be familiar with the area 熟悉該地區
items.distinct: be acquainted with 認識；了解 | be aware of 知道；意識到
ex: Are you familiar with our software interface?
你熟悉我們的軟體介面嗎？
He is familiar with the local market trends.
他熟悉當地的市場趨勢。
I am not familiar with these new regulations.
我不熟悉這些新規定。

items.colloc: exchange business cards 交換名片 | hand out business cards 發送名片
items.distinct: ID card 識別證 | credit card 信用卡
ex: May I have your business card for reference?
我可以拿你的名片做參考嗎？
He handed over his business card after the meeting.
他在會議後遞上了他的名片。
We should print more business cards for the event.
我們應該為活動多印一些名片。

items.colloc: go on a business trip 去出差 | business trip expenses 出差費用
items.distinct: official visit 公務訪問 | field trip 校外教學
ex: He is currently away on a business trip in Japan.
他目前正在日本出差。
Please submit your business trip report by Friday afternoon.
請在週五下午前提交出差報告。
Our company will cover all expenses for your business trip.
公司將支付您所有的出差費用。

items.colloc: call for action 採取行動 | call for support 尋求支援
items.distinct: call off 取消 | ask for 要求
ex: The current market situation calls for a new strategy.
當前的市場情況需要採取新的策略。
Management called for an immediate meeting to discuss sales.
管理層要求立即召開會議討論銷售狀況。
This complex problem calls for a highly skilled expert.
這個複雜的問題需要高水準的專家來處理。

items.colloc: close down a business 結束營業 | close down a factory 關閉工廠
items.distinct: shut down 臨時關閉（機器/系統） | go bankrupt 破產
ex: The local branch had to close down due to poor sales.
由於銷售不佳，分公司被迫關閉。
Many small retailers closed down during the economic downturn.
許多小型零售商在經濟衰退期間倒閉了。
They decided to close down the warehouse by the end of year.
他們決定在年底前關閉倉庫。

items.colloc: launch a clothing line 推出服裝系列 | popular clothing line 受歡迎的服裝系列
items.distinct: fashion collection 時裝系列 | product line 產品線
ex: The designer is launching a new winter clothing line soon.
設計師即將推出全新的冬季服裝系列。
Our company focuses on a sustainable clothing line for adults.
我們公司專注於成人永續服裝系列。
Her clothing line has become very popular among young professionals.
她的服裝系列在年輕專業人士中非常受歡迎。

items.colloc: come over to my office 到我辦公室來 | come over for a meeting 順道來開會
items.distinct: drop by 順道拜訪 | visit 參觀；拜訪
ex: Would you like to come over to discuss the proposal today?
你今天想過來討論一下提案嗎？
Several clients will come over to see our new prototype.
幾位客戶會過來參觀我們的新原型機。
Please come over to the main building for the signing.
請到主棟大樓來進行簽約。

items.colloc: contact a customer service representative 聯繫客服專員 | professional customer service representative 專業客服專員
items.distinct: sales representative 銷售代表 | technical support 技術支援
ex: A customer service representative will assist you with the return.
客服專員將協助您處理退貨事宜。
I spoke to a customer service representative about my account.
我和客服專員討論了我的帳戶問題。
You can reach a customer service representative via our hotline.
您可以透過我們的熱線聯繫客服專員。

items.colloc: as a result of the delay 因為延誤 | as a result of the policy 因為這項政策
items.distinct: due to 由於（常接名詞）| because of 因為（連接詞引導原因）
ex: The flight was canceled as a result of the storm.
由於暴風雨，航班被取消了。
Sales rose as a result of the new campaign.
由於新的促銷活動，銷售額上升了。
Production stopped as a result of the strike.
由於罷工，生產停止了。

items.colloc: drop by the office 順道去辦公室 | drop by later 稍後順道來
items.distinct: come over 專程過來 | visit 正式拜訪
ex: Feel free to drop by my office if you have questions.
如果有問題，歡迎隨時順道來我辦公室。
I will drop by your desk to collect the signed documents.
我會順道經過你的座位收取簽名文件。
Could you drop by before the meeting starts this afternoon?
你能在今天下午會議開始前順道過來嗎？

items.colloc: end up in trouble 結果惹上麻煩 | end up doing something 最終做了某事
items.distinct: turn out 結果是（情況） | result in 導致
ex: We ended up hiring the candidate with the most experience.
我們最終錄用了那位最有經驗的候選人。
If you do not plan properly, you might end up over budget.
如果沒有妥善規劃，你最終可能會超出預算。
The project ended up being a great success for our team.
這個專案最終對我們團隊而言是一個巨大的成功。

items.colloc: feel sick to one's stomach 感到噁心 | call in sick 因病請假
items.distinct: be ill 生病（狀態） | feel nauseous 感到反胃
ex: He started to feel sick after eating the cafeteria lunch.
吃了員工餐廳的午餐後，他開始感到身體不適。
Please call the supervisor if you feel sick this morning.
如果您今天早上感到不適，請致電主管。
I felt sick during the presentation due to the stress.
因為壓力的關係，我在簡報時感到身體不太舒服。
